albumDerived.hueGuard: hues 250-340 deg move to 215 (below 295) or 8 (295 and above); saturation capped at 0.3 for hues 230-250 and 340-360

title2.purpose: Section headers and Stats section titles.

title3.purpose: Feature-card titles; Library destination rows at 400.

headline.purpose: Button labels, nav titles, mini-player title.

footnote.purpose: Subtitles, grouped headers and footers, summaries.

extensions.tracking: letterSpacing = size * (-0.0223 + 0.185 * e^(-0.1745 * size)); Inter Display at size >= 20 and weight >= 500

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.value: 0 calc(5% of size) calc(12% of size) <album deep 40% to black @ 55%>

shadows.name: bar-disc

shadows.name: dragged-row

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Pill and button state changes, row press release.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Tab selection pill slide, press release, cover landing.

motion.name: press
motion.value: scale to 0.90-0.99 on pointer-down in 90ms; spring back over 260ms
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback in place of ripples.

motion.name: field-energy
motion.value: 620ms easeOutCubic in, 420ms easeInOutCubic out; instant under reduced motion
motion.purpose: Artwork field light (uEnergy): playing raises saturation (1.38 + 0.24) and opens the region behind the cover only; paused dims the field.

motion.name: cover-deck
motion.value: spring; neighbours 28 apart, depth scale 1 - 0.08; rubber band x*s/(|x|+s), s = 0.35 stride
motion.purpose: Swiped and external skips glide along one deck; unrelated jumps, open panes and reduced motion cross-fade.

motion.name: play-pause-swap
motion.value: 200ms fade + scale 0.6 to 1, easeOutBack in / easeInCubic out

motion.name: glyph-pop
motion.purpose: A glyph that changes state (star outline to filled) pops in.

motion.name: title-swap
motion.purpose: Now Playing title on song change.

motion.name: queue-mode
motion.purpose: Queue mode button on/off and busy spinner.

narrative.overview:
NaviVibe is the iOS 26 Apple Music app rebuilt at full fidelity for Android phones, with a faithful wide layout on Linux and Windows desktops. It has two translations and no others: green (systemGreen #30D158) where Apple uses red, and a pure AMOLED black ground (with no tint) where Apple uses its neutral system greys. Everything else follows Apple's conventions. That means large titles that collapse into a compact bar, inset grouped lists, a floating capsule tab bar with Search split into its own circle, a capsule mini player, iOS page transitions with edge-swipe back, rubber-band scrolling, and presses that respond on touch-down by scaling instead of rippling.

The chrome is exact, quiet and opaque. Artwork is the main decoration and the only source of chrome colour. The default chrome stays on the same black ramp whatever is playing. Icons are monochrome and tinted by their role (Ionicons in the player and Settings, CupertinoIcons elsewhere); the one place fixed colour is drawn by hand is the illustrated set: the phone tab icons and the empty-state illustrations. Album colour appears in three places only: the living artwork field behind Now Playing, the mini player (filled with the playing cover's ground), and collection pages (album, playlist, artist), whose ground is sampled from the cover with the artwork dissolving into it. Every sampled colour passes a hue guard, so purple and pink never reach the chrome.

The density is Apple's. The page gutter is 16, rows are at least 48 to 52 tall with hairline separators inset past the art, and sections are separated by space rather than boxes. Stats reads like Apple Fitness or Health: big figures and charts set straight on the page, with no cards.
keyCharacteristics: There is one theme. The chrome uses a single AMOLED black ramp, and system green is the only accent.
Every role is an opaque colour. The only gradient seam is artwork dissolving into its own page colour.
Collection pages and the mini player take a hue-guarded ground from the cover. On those pages foreground is white only.
The type is Inter and Inter Display on Apple's text-style ladder, with size-specific (dynamic-metrics) tracking.
Depth comes from tonal steps of the ground. Shadows are kept for artwork lifting off a page and for floating discs over artwork.
Phone Now Playing has three transport controls. Shuffle and repeat live in the queue.
The artwork field's light follows the music, and covers move on one deck whether you swipe or skip.

rules.name: The Opaque Chrome Rule
rules.body: Every chrome role is a solid colour. No blur, no translucent bars, no glass. The only gradient allowed is artwork dissolving into its own page colour: the collection-page seam, the Top Picks card seam, and the edge fade on scrolling panes.

rules.name: The Green, Never Purple Rule
rules.body: Any colour derived from a cover goes through the hue guard. Hues from 250° to 340° are moved to 215° (blue) or 8° (red), and saturation within 20° of either edge of that band is capped at 0.3. The cover image itself is never altered. No purple or pink chrome is ever authored by hand either.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: System green is the only accent in default chrome. On artwork-coloured pages and on Now Playing the accent becomes white. Nothing else gets a brand colour. Monochrome glyphs take their colour from their role, never from the asset.

rules.name: The Dynamic Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing is never hand-set. It always comes from `trackingFor(size) = size × (−0.0223 + 0.185·e^(−0.1745·size))`: small text opens slightly and display text tightens.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Times, counts and figures use tabular numerals so values don't jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: Use the next opaque step of the ground before reaching for a shadow. Panels, cards and sections never get shadows.

dos: **Do** read every colour, size and radius through `ThemeTokens.of(context)`, `Space`, `Radii` and `Motion`.
**Do** derive collection-page and mini-player colour from `AlbumPalette.ground` and theme the page with `AppThemeTokens.tinted`, so shared widgets turn white-on-colour without special cases.
**Do** publish a page's ground with `DockGroundScope` so the dock band matches it.
**Do** keep text at 4.5:1 or better against its actual ground. Use Secondary Label for any text that must read on tinted pages.
**Do** give every control a touch target of at least 44pt and a semantic label.
**Do** draw player and Settings glyphs with `IonIcon`, tinted by role; use CupertinoIcons elsewhere.
**Do** keep phone Now Playing to three transport controls (rewind, play/pause, forward), with shuffle and repeat in the queue.
**Do** honour reduced motion for field drift, the field light (instant), the marquee, count-up figures, the cover scale, the deck glide and the tab illustrations.
donts: **Don't** add blur, glass, translucent bars or scrims over chrome. Chrome is opaque.
**Don't** paint chrome purple or pink, by hand or from a sampled colour that skipped the hue guard.
**Don't** add eyebrow kickers, numbered sections, glows or gradient text.
**Don't** put Stats sections in cards. Type, space and the charts carry the structure.
**Don't** add a second accent or a theme picker. There is one living theme.
**Don't** use Material ripples, bottom navigation bars or chip-and-card Android scaffolding.
**Don't** show a format badge the file doesn't earn: "Lossless" appears only for lossless suffixes.
